## 描述

Ford oil filter, OE reference 1S7J-6744-BA. The source names Ford and the passenger segment but withholds the thread, canister dimensions, micron rating and relief setting. Ford engines split across several filter families, so the OE number is the practical key and the exact engine must be matched rather than assumed. Our advice is to ask the supplier for the spec sheet to verify the gasket seat and thread, and give the oil grade and drain interval so the media lines up with the service schedule.
